name: Automated bank transaction import into Actual Budget

mentions.name: Automated bank transaction import into Actual Budget
mentions.description: This automation pulls transactions from the author's Canadian banks and imports them into Actual Budget, using AI to replace unreliable third-party sync services.
mentions.problem: SimpleFIN or Plaid type services frequently break, make mistakes or require reauthentication every few hours for Canadian banks due to the lack of open banking, making them not so useful.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently I automated pulling transactions from my banks (Canada, no open banking..) and putting them into Actual Budget.
mentions.author: zaptheimpaler
